intent.proves: Product images with a default: image-share satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT ISNULL(100 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND p.ProductActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') = N''{inScope} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailProductId = p.ProductId AND d.DetailType = 0) OR ISNULL(p.ProductImageSmall, N'') + ISNULL(p.ProductImageMedium, N'') + ISNULL(p.ProductImageLarge, N'') <> N'')) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND p.ProductActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') = N''{inScope}), 0), 0)
